deferrals.summary: ci.yml's lint-manifest real-download-and-digest-verify pass runs for linux-x86_64 only, so the four other newly-changed per-os/arch ruff digests (linux-arm64, macos-x86_64, macos-arm64, windows-x86_64) are hash-verified nowhere in CI; and the 'provisioned run reports 0.16.4' clause is asserted as runs-not-reports. A wrong/transposed digest on a non-linux-x86_64 platform would ship undetected until a consumer on that platform provisions and fails closed.
deferrals.explanation: The issue's testing strategy delegates digest verification to the provisioning path's own digest verification and does not mandate a CI-matrix expansion; editing ci.yml is a scope expansion beyond issue #2009. The five digests were independently spot-verified out-of-band against astral's published .sha256 (linux-x86_64, windows-x86_64, macos-arm64 all exact-match), so no shipped defect is implied — this tracks a CI-automation enhancement for a follow-up.
